definitions: To narrowly avoid a dangerous, unpleasant, or difficult situation.
To escape a potentially very bad outcome.
examples: I really dodged a bullet when I missed that flight, as it ended up being delayed for hours.
She dodged a bullet by not investing in that failing company.
He thought he dodged a bullet by avoiding the meeting, but then he had to do all the extra work.
synonyms: to be out of the woods
